CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Public Storage, a member of the S&P 500, is a REIT that primarily acquires, develops, owns, and operates self-storage facilities. At September 30, 2026, we: (i) owned and/or operated 4,764 self-storage facilities with approximately 339 million net rentable square feet located in 42 states, Puerto Rico and Canada and (ii) owned a 35% common equity interest in Shurgard Self Storage Limited (Euronext Brussels: SHUR), which owned 338 self-storage facilities located in seven Western European countries with approximately 19 million net rentable square feet operated under the Shurgard brand. Our headquarters are located in Frisco, Texas.
